value.rationale: The source learning model interprets learning-rate diversity as a mechanism maintaining cooperation. Its interior critical-reciprocity equilibria are natural knife-edge candidate states. A complete structural instability test under arbitrary heterogeneous rates is a motivated dynamical distinction, not a minor numerical parameter calculation. The negative determinant is a weighted variance, giving an exact geometric interpretation and universal N-independent conclusion. It separates stationary gradient neutrality from robust dynamical attraction without overclaiming global learning outcomes.
